problems.statement: Let $f(x) = \sin{\left(x \right)} \cos{\left(x \right)}$. Find the exact value of $f'\left(\frac{\pi}{6}\right)$.
hints: Differentiate first, then substitute the angle.
$f'(x) = - \sin^{2}{\left(x \right)} + \cos^{2}{\left(x \right)}$; recall the exact values of sine and cosine at $\frac{\pi}{6}$.

problems.statement: Let $f(x) = \sec{\left(x \right)}$. Find the exact value of $f'\left(\frac{\pi}{3}\right)$.
hints: Differentiate first, then substitute the angle.
$f'(x) = \tan{\left(x \right)} \sec{\left(x \right)}$; recall the exact values of sine and cosine at $\frac{\pi}{3}$.

problems.statement: Let $f(x) = x \cos{\left(x \right)}$. Find the exact value of $f'\left(\frac{\pi}{4}\right)$.
hints: Differentiate first, then substitute the angle.
$f'(x) = - x \sin{\left(x \right)} + \cos{\left(x \right)}$; recall the exact values of sine and cosine at $\frac{\pi}{4}$.

problems.statement: Let $f(x) = \tan{\left(x \right)}$. Find the exact value of $f'\left(0\right)$.
hints: Differentiate first, then substitute the angle.
$f'(x) = \tan^{2}{\left(x \right)} + 1$; recall the exact values of sine and cosine at $0$.

problems.statement: Let $f(x) = x + \sin{\left(x \right)}$. Find the exact value of $f'\left(\pi\right)$.
hints: Differentiate first, then substitute the angle.
$f'(x) = \cos{\left(x \right)} + 1$; recall the exact values of sine and cosine at $\pi$.

problems.statement: Let $f(x) = \tan{\left(x \right)}$. Find the exact value of $f'\left(\frac{\pi}{6}\right)$.

problems.statement: Let $f(x) = \sin{\left(x \right)} + 2 \cos{\left(x \right)}$. Find the exact value of $f'\left(\frac{\pi}{3}\right)$.
hints: Differentiate first, then substitute the angle.
$f'(x) = - 2 \sin{\left(x \right)} + \cos{\left(x \right)}$; recall the exact values of sine and cosine at $\frac{\pi}{3}$.

problems.statement: Find an equation of the tangent line to $y = x \sin{\left(x \right)}$ at the point where $x = \frac{\pi}{4}$.
hints: Slope $= f'(\frac{\pi}{4})$; the point is $(\frac{\pi}{4}, f(\frac{\pi}{4}))$.
$f'(x) = x \cos{\left(x \right)} + \sin{\left(x \right)}$.

problems.statement: Find an equation of the tangent line to $y = \tan{\left(x \right)}$ at the point where $x = 0$.
hints: Slope $= f'(0)$; the point is $(0, f(0))$.
$f'(x) = \tan^{2}{\left(x \right)} + 1$.

problems.statement: Find an equation of the tangent line to $y = \cos{\left(x \right)}$ at the point where $x = 0$.
hints: Slope $= f'(0)$; the point is $(0, f(0))$.
$f'(x) = - \sin{\left(x \right)}$.

problems.statement: Find an equation of the tangent line to $y = \sin{\left(x \right)}$ at the point where $x = \frac{\pi}{3}$.
hints: Slope $= f'(\frac{\pi}{3})$; the point is $(\frac{\pi}{3}, f(\frac{\pi}{3}))$.
$f'(x) = \cos{\left(x \right)}$.
